tools.name: resourceguru_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Resource Guru accounts this user can access, with each account's subdomain. Call this first: the subdomain is the `account` argument of every other tool. Scope: accounts:read. API: GET /v1/accounts.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_my_user
tools.description: Get the signed-in Resource Guru user: name, email, timezone, and rights across accounts. Scope: users:read. API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_users
tools.description: List the active users of an account (people who can sign in). Scope: users:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/users.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_resources
tools.description: List the active resources of an account. A resource is a person or item that can be booked. Set `show_availability` for custom availability periods. Scope: resources:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/resources.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_resource
tools.description: Get one resource by id, with its type, timezone, notes, custom field values and booking approvers. Scope: resources:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/resources/{id}.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_resource_types
tools.description: List the resource types of an account (for example people or equipment). Scope: resources:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/resource_types.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_clients
tools.description: List the active clients of an account. Set `include_archived` to also return archived clients; then `limit` and `offset` are ignored. Scope: clients:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/clients.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its notes and custom field values. Scope: clients:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/clients/{id}.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_projects
tools.description: List the active projects of an account. Set `include_archived` to also return archived projects; then `limit` and `offset` are ignored. Scope: projects:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/projects.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, with its client, dates, team, notes and custom field values. Scope: projects:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/projects/{id}.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_tasks
tools.description: List planner tasks, optionally for one project or phase. Scope: planning:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/tasks.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_phases
tools.description: List project phases (planner stages with start and end dates). Filter by project or by resource (`me` = the signed-in user). Scope: planning:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/phases.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_milestones
tools.description: List milestones (dated markers on projects), optionally by project, date range or resource (`me` = the signed-in user). Scope: planning:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/milestones.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings in a date range, optionally for some resources, a booker (`me` = the signed-in user), approval states, or the waiting list. Scope: bookings:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/bookings.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: resources, dates, duration, booker, project, client, approval state and notes. Scope: bookings:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: resourceguru_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking for one or more resources (a write: it changes the schedule). Give `resource_id` or `resource_ids`. `duration` is minutes per day (1-1440), or total minutes when `effort_flexibility` is set. This tool never books overtime or a waiting list: a clash returns the vendor's error. Scope:

tools.name: resourceguru_list_downtimes
tools.description: List downtimes (time off, leave and other unavailable periods) in a date range, optionally for some resources or a booker. Scope: downtimes:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/downtimes.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_timesheets
tools.description: List logged timesheet entries in a date range, optionally for some resources. Scope: timesheets:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/timesheets.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_timesheet_report_by_resource
tools.description: Total logged time per resource in a date range. Set `approved_only` to count approved entries only. Scope: timesheets:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/timesheets/reports/resources.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_timesheet_report_by_project
tools.description: Total logged time per project in a date range. Set `approved_only` to count approved entries only. Scope: timesheets:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/timesheets/reports/projects.

tools.name: resourceguru_get_utilization_report
tools.description: Report per resource for a date range (both dates required): scheduled, available, unscheduled, overtime, downtime, waiting list and utilization. Scope: reports:read. API: GET /v2/{account}/reports/resources.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_rates
tools.description: List the hourly rates of an account and the resources on each. Scope: rates:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/rates.

tools.name: resourceguru_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of an account (their labels, types and the entities they apply to). Scope: custom-fields:read. API: GET /v1/{account}/custom_fields.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resourceguru_get_my_user, resourceguru_create_booking · Public sink: resourceguru_get_my_user, resourceguru_create_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resourceguru_get_my_user, resourceguru_create_booking · Public sink: resourceguru_get_my_user, resourceguru_create_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
